name: Hotel Villa Real
positioning: Art-filled Derby Hotels Collection hotel on Plaza de las Cortes in central Madrid, a few steps from the Prado, Thyssen-Bornemisza and Reina Sofia museums
best_for: Art lovers who want to explore Madrid's museums on foot
Families wanting a two-level family room

facts.text: The hotel is on Plaza de las Cortes, opposite the Congress of Deputies.
The hotel is a few steps from the museum triangle formed by the Prado, the Thyssen-Bornemisza and the Reina Sofia.
The hotel is a few minutes from Atocha Station and a few meters from Retiro Park.
Hotel Villa Real is part of Derby Hotels Collection.
The Junior Suites have balconies with views of Calle del Prado.
Superior rooms overlooking the interior courtyard are very quiet.
Family rooms sleep up to four people over two levels, each level with its own bedroom and en-suite bathroom.
A Guest Relations and Concierge team provides personalized support.
Toiletries are from The White Company.
East Restaurant & Bar serves Mediterranean-inspired tapas.

highlights.text: Guests find a collection of art and antiquities throughout the public areas, including ancient Roman sculptures and mosaics and Apulian vases.
The hotel's event spaces are decorated with authentic Roman mosaics and Apulian vases from Magna Graecia.
The Suites are spread over two levels and each has its own private terrace.
The Grand Suite is on the hotel's fifth floor and has a bedroom, bathroom, foyer and balcony.
Dogs receive a kit with a bed, food and water bowls, and toys and treats.

considerations.text: The rooftop terrace and pool are open in summer only.
Smoking is prohibited in all indoor areas and rooms.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
